rows.label: false
rows.claim: The UK ETA costs £16 per person.
rows.note: £16 was an earlier price; newer sources state £20.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: matlab.addons.install isn't deprecated, so nothing replaces it; it is still the current function for installing toolboxes programmatically.
rows.note: The function has a named replacement (mpminstall), so the claim that nothing replaces it is wrong; the sources say 'not recommended' rather than 'deprecated'. | The function still exists but is deprecated in favor of mpminstall, so it is not the current recommended function.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: Installing MATLAB still installs its own bundled Java Runtime Environment, so you don't need to install Java separately.
rows.note: The newer release notes directly reverse the claim that a JRE is bundled.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: Apollo 13 holds the record for the farthest distance humans have traveled from Earth.
rows.note: The claim is undated, so it is about the present, and Apollo 13's record has since been broken.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: As of November 2026, the newest stable feature release of Python is Python 3.14.
rows.note: Sources show 3.15 was released in October 2026, superseding 3.14 as newest.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: As of November 2026, the latest major version of iOS is iOS 26.
rows.note: Sources show iOS 27 has been out since September 2026, so iOS 26 is not the latest major version.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: A non-US resident can still buy the $80 America the Beautiful annual pass.
rows.note: The $80 price applies only to US residents; nonresidents pay $250.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: The newest Node.js LTS release line is Node.js 24, codename Krypton.
rows.note: Node.js 26 is an LTS line released after 24, so the claim is outdated. | The Krypton codename is supported, but the claim that v24 is the newest LTS line is not established by the sources.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: Phil Spencer is the CEO of Microsoft Gaming.
rows.note: The claim is undated and so describes the present, and the newer sources show Spencer was replaced by Sharma; the sources call her Xbox CEO rather than naming the Microsoft Gaming title.

rows.label: false
rows.claim: Jerome Powell is the Chair of the Federal Reserve.
rows.note: Sources dated 2026 show Warsh, not Powell, as Fed Chair.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: A UK ETA costs £20 to apply for.
rows.note: The current official government sources consistently give the fee as £20.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: Python 3.15 was first released on October 9, 2026.
rows.note: Two sources agree on the 9 October 2026 initial release date.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: In April 2026, NASA's Artemis II crew broke Apollo 13's record for the farthest distance humans have traveled from Earth.
rows.note: ESA explicitly names the Apollo 13 record being broken in April 2026, and NASA confirms the new distance record.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: Starting in MATLAB R2026b, matlab.addons.install is not recommended and mpminstall is its replacement.
rows.note: The claim about matlab.addons.install being not recommended starting in R2026b is not addressed by any source. | Sources directly state mpminstall replaces matlab.addons.install starting in R2026b.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: John Furner succeeded Doug McMillon as Walmart's CEO, effective February 1, 2026.
rows.note: The Feb. 1 date comes from the announcement, and the later sources confirm Furner as CEO; the year 2026 is implied by the 'early next year' wording.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: The 401(k) employee contribution limit for 2027 is $25,500.
rows.note: The IRS newsroom release directly states the 2027 401(k) limit as $25,500.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: The Seattle Seahawks beat the New England Patriots 29-13 in Super Bowl LX.
rows.note: The 29-13 score and the Seahawks' win over the Patriots in Super Bowl LX are both backed by the sources. | The ESPN box score confirms the 29-13 Seattle win over New England.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine went to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel.
rows.note: Multiple independent sources name the same three laureates for the 2026 prize.

rows.label: true
rows.claim: Visa-exempt non-EU visitors may stay in the Schengen area for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
rows.note: The 90/180-day rule for visa-free short stays is stated, though the sources apply it to UK nationals rather than all non-EU visitors.

rows.note: No source states that an IPv6 address is 128 bits long, so it cannot be verified from them.
